items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Now, another thing I remember about him when Lois Armstrong was leaving here to go to Chicago.

ctx.x: At that time, at that time, it just started at 8, to get to Bureus there to leave you about 2, 3 and even if they were riding, unless you catch the little train at Canal and River. You just come all the way to Canal and River and have a little train. Right. But if you go in the car, it would take you 3 to 4 hours to get the Bureus down the road, you know what I'm saying?
Now, another thing I remember about him when Lois Armstrong was leaving here to go to Chicago. Wasn't it Chicago?
